help_and_support_subtitle: Izikhokelo, imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo, kunye noqhagamshelwano
guide_notes_p1: Khetha nawuphi na umbhalo ukuze usebenzise Ubungqindilili okanye Italic kwibar yezixhobo edadayo — unokudibanisa zombini kwigama elinye.
guide_notes_p2: Qhagamshela iifoto kwi-gallery okanye kwikhamera yakho ngokuthe ngqo kwinqaku; imifanekiso igcinwa kwindawo ekuyo kwaye ihlala ifihliwe.
guide_notes_p3: Phina inqaku ukuze uligcine phezulu kuluhlu lwakho — cofa imenyu ye-⋮ okanye ucinezele ixesha elide ikhadi ukuze uphine okanye ukhuphe.
guide_checklist_p1: Cofa kwibhokisi yokukhangela ukuze uphawule into egqityiweyo; cofa i-icon yokuhlela ukuze utshintshe phakathi kwezi: Ezisalindileyo kuqala, Ezigqityiweyo kuqala, okanye uhlelo luka-A→Z.
guide_checklist_p2: Swayiphela ngasekhohlo kumqolo ukuze uwucime ngoko nangoko. Imbonakalo ebanzi ibonisa into nganye kumgca omnye.
guide_checklist_p3: Ikhadi lenqaku libonisa inani elipheleleyo lezinto kunye nokuba zingaphi ezigqityiweyo — imbonakalo ekhawulezayo yenkqubela ngaphandle kokuvula inqaku.
guide_itinerary_p1: Ingeniso nganye yendawo ekuyiwa kuyo iqulethe igama lendawo, ixesha lokufika, ixesha lokuhamba, kunye nendawo yamanqaku yeereferensi zokubhukisha okanye izikhombisi.
guide_itinerary_p2: Cofa kwitshiphu yomhla okanye ixesha kuyo nayiphi na ingeniso ukuze uvule isikhethi kwaye ucwangcise kwakhona — iingeniso zihlala ngokulandelelana kwexesha ngokuzenzekelayo.
guide_itinerary_p3: Ikhadi lenqaku libonisa imbonakalo yento eza kubakho yenani elipheleleyo leendawo ekuyiwa kuzo ukuze ubone umda wohambo lwakho shwaka.
guide_meal_plan_p1: Umqolo ngamnye wemihla unemixube yesidlo sakusasa, isidlo sasemini, isidlo sangokuhlwa, kunye neesnack — shiya izithuba zingenanto okanye uzisuse ukuba akuyimfuneko. Yongeza imiqolo njengoko kuyimfuneko.
guide_meal_plan_p2: Cofa kwisithuba sokutya ukuze uchwetheze igama lesitya okanye wongeze amanqaku akhawulezayo afana nezikhumbuzo zokulungiselela; utshintsho lugcinwa ngokuzenzekelayo.
guide_meal_plan_p3: Ikhadi lenqaku libonisa ukuba zingaphi iintsuku ezicwangcisiweyo, ukunika imbonakalo ekhawulezayo ngaphandle kokuvula inqaku elipheleleyo.
guide_recipe_p1: Beka ixesha lokulungiselela, ixesha lokupheka, kunye nokusebenza phezulu — iinkonzo zivela kwikhadi lenqaku ukuze ubhekise kuyo ngokukhawuleza.
guide_recipe_p2: Yongeza izithako ngamagama kunye nobungakanani; rhola isiphatho kuwo nawuphi na umqolo ukuze uhlele kwakhona ngaphandle kokucima kwaye wongeze kwakhona.
guide_recipe_p3: Amanyathelo anikwa amanani ngokuzenzekelayo — faka inyathelo naphi na kuluhlu kwaye amanani aya kuhlaziya ngokwawo.
guide_drawing_p1: Khetha iPen, Highlighter, okanye iEraser kwibar yezixhobo engezantsi; lungisa umbala womgca kunye nobukhulu phambi kokuba uzobe.
guide_drawing_p2: Undo kwaye redo umgca ngamnye ngokwahlukileyo usebenzisa amaqhosha e-↩ / ↪ — bamba naliphi na iqhosha ukuze uqhubeleke ngokukhawuleza kwimbali.
guide_drawing_p3: Cofa kwi-Export Image kwibar yezixhobo ukuze ugcine umzobo wakho kwi-gallery yesixhobo njengomfanekiso we-PNG kwisisombululo esipheleleyo.
guide_security_p1: Onke amanqaku aqhelekileyo kunye nemizobo ifihliwe nge-AES-256 kusetyenziswa isitshixo esivela kwigama lakho lokugqitha eliphambili — ayinakufundwa ngaphandle kwaso.
guide_security_p2: Emva kokuvula ngempumelelo okokuqala, vula i-biometrics phantsi kweSetingi ukuze ufumane ukufikelela okukhawulezayo ngomnwe okanye ubuso.
guide_security_p3: I-icon eluhlaza 🔒 kwikhadi lenqaku ithetha ukuba ifihliwe ngegama lokugqitha eliphambili langoku. I-icon yetsitshisi ye-orenji ithetha ukuba ifihliwe ngegama lokugqitha eliphambili elahlukileyo — faka igama lokugqitha lokuqala ukuze ulifunde.
guide_sync_p1: Ngena nge-Google phantsi kweSetingi → Iakhawunti; cofa Layisha okanye Buyisela ukuze uthumele okanye ufumane idatha — sebenzisa iakhawunti efanayo kwisixhobo ngasinye.
guide_sync_p2: Emva kokufaka kwakhona, ngena kwaye ucofe Buyisela kwi-Drive — usetyenziso luthatha ityuwa yakho yokufihla ukuze onke amanqaku acaciswe ngokuchanekileyo.
guide_sync_p3: Xa inqaku elinye lihlelwa kwizixhobo ezimbini, impixano iphawulwa ukuze ukwazi ukukhetha Gcina Indawo, Gcina Indawo Ekude, okanye Gcina Zombini.
guide_controls_p1: Cofa ikhadi lenqaku ukuze ulivule; ucinezele ixesha elide naliphi na ikhadi ukuze ungene kwimowudi yokukhetha amaninzi — emva koko cofa amanye amakhadi ukuze uwongeze kuluhlu olukhethiweyo.
guide_controls_p2: Swayiphela ikhadi ngasekhohlo ukuze ulisuse. Ngaphakathi kwenqaku, cofa ⋮ ukuze uphine, utshintshe umbala, utshintshe udidi, wongeze umfanekiso, okanye ucime inqaku.
guide_controls_p3: Cofa i-icon yeliso 👁 kwikhadi naliphi na ukuze ubone inqaku ngaphandle kokuvula umhleli — iluncedo ekufundeni ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokushiya uluhlu.
guide_organisation_p1: Cofa i-icon yokukhangela 🔍 kwibar ephezulu ukuze ukhangele kwiintlobo zonke zamanqaku — iziphumo zihambelana nezihloko, umbhalo womzimba, izinto zoluhlu lokukhangela, iindawo ekuyiwa kuzo, iingeniso zokutya, kunye nezithako zeresiphi kwangaxeshanye.
guide_organisation_p2: Cofa i-icon yokuhlela ukuze utshintshe phakathi kwezi: Ezintsha kuqala, Ezidala kuqala, okanye imbonakalo yodidi — kwimbonakalo yodidi iqela ngalinye (Jikelele, Umsebenzi, Ubunjani, Iingcamango) linokugoqwa.
guide_organisation_p3: Yabela udidi kwinqaku naliphi na ngaphakathi komhleli usebenzisa umqolo weetshiphu phantsi kwesihloko; yabela umbala usebenzisa ⋮ → Tshintsha Umbala ukuze wahlule amanqaku ngokubonakalayo shwaka.
faq_lock_icon_q: Kutheni inqaku lam libonisa i-icon yetsitshisi ye-orenji nomyalezo wegama lokugqitha ohlukileyo?
faq_lock_icon_a: I-icon yetsitshisi ye-orenji ithetha ukuba inqaku lifihliwe ngegama lokugqitha eliphambili elahlukileyo kwelo layishiweyo ngoku. Oku kwenzeka ngokubanzi emva kokufaka kwakhona usetyenziso kunye nokudala igama lokugqitha eliphambili elitsha. Faka igama lokugqitha lokuqala elisetyenziswe xa inqaku lenziwa ukuze ulifikelele.
faq_forgot_password_q: Kwenzeka ntoni ukuba ndilibale igama lam lokugqitha eliphambili?
faq_forgot_password_a: Amanqaku afihliwe end-to-end nge-AES-256 kwaye igama lokugqitha alinakubuyiselwa nabani na — kubandakanya umphuhlisi. Ukuba unogcino lwe-Google Drive olwenziwe ngexesha usalazi igama lokugqitha, luphinde luvele kwaye ufake igama lokugqitha elichanekileyo. Ngaphandle kwegama lokugqitha lokuqala, amanqaku afihliweyo awakwazi ukufikelelwa. Oku kuyilelwe ngabom ukukhusela ubumfihlo bakho.
faq_sync_devices_q: Ngalivula njani ukungqamanisa amanqaku phakathi kwezixhobo?
faq_sync_devices_a: Yiya kusetingi → Iakhawunti kwaye ungene ngeakhawunti ye-Google efanayo kwisixhobo ngasinye. Cofa Qala Ngoku ukuze ulayishe okanye ukhuphele. Emva kokufaka kwakhona kwisixhobo esitsha, ngena kuqala uze ucofe Buyisela kwi-Drive — usetyenziso luthatha ityuwa yakho yokufihla ukuze igama lakho lokugqitha eliphambili likwazi ukucacisa yonke into ngokuchanekileyo.
faq_notes_missing_q: Kutheni amanqaku am engaveli emva kokufaka kwakhona?
faq_notes_missing_a: Amanqaku asekhohlo agcinwa kwisixhobo kwaye ayasuswa xa ukhuphela usetyenziso. Ukuba i-Drive sync yayivuliwe, ngena kwakhona phantsi kweSetingi → Iakhawunti kwaye ucofe Buyisela kwi-Drive. Ukuba uthumele ugcino lwe-JSON ngeSetingi → Ugcino → Khuphela Amanqaku JSON, cofa Layisha Amanqaku JSON ukuze uwangenise kwakhona.
faq_no_account_a: Ewe — iintlobo ezintandathu zamanqaku (Inqaku, Uluhlu lokukhangela, Isicwangciso sohambo, Isicwangciso sokutya, Iresiphi, Ukuzoba) zisebenza ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kwe-intanethi ngaphandle kokufuna iakhawunti. Amanqaku agcinwa kwaye afihliwe kwisixhobo. Iakhawunti iyimfuneko kuphela ukuba ufuna i-Google Drive sync okanye ugcino phakathi kwezixhobo.
faq_export_backup_q: Ngalithumela njani okanye ndigcine amanqaku am?
faq_export_backup_a: Eli nqaku okwangoku lifumaneka kuphela kubasebenzisi be-Google Sync. Yiya kusetingi → Ugcino kwaye ucofe Khuphela Amanqaku JSON ukuze ugcine ifayile yogcino efihliweyo kwisixhobo sakho. Ukuze ubuyisele, cofa Layisha Amanqaku JSON kwaye ukhethe loo fayile. Amanqaku ahlala efihliwe ngaphakathi kwifayile, ngoko ke ugcino lukhuselekile ukugcinwa naphi na.
faq_canvas_preview_q: Kutheni ilaphu libonakala lahlukile kuluhlu lokukhangela?
faq_canvas_preview_a: Ikhadi lenqaku libonisa isithombe esincinci selaphu lakho ngenxa yokusebenza. Umzobo oselisisombululo esipheleleyo uhlala ugcinwa — cofa inqaku ukuze ulivule kubungakanani obupheleleyo. Isithombe esincinci sihlaziywa qho xa ugcina.
faq_biometrics_a: Emva kokufaka igama lakho lokugqitha eliphambili ngokuchanekileyo okokuqala, unokubhalisa i-biometrics phantsi kweSetingi. Kwiminyhadala elandelayo, i-prompt yomunwe okanye ubuso ivela ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukuba ukuqinisekiswa kwe-biometric kuyasilela okanye kurhoxiswa, usetyenziso lubuyela kwisikrini segama lokugqitha eliphambili.
faq_reorder_checklist_q: Ndingazihlela kwakhona okanye ndihlele izinto zoluhlu lokukhangela?
faq_reorder_checklist_a: Ewe. Ngaphakathi kwenqaku loluhlu lokukhangela, cofa i-icon yokuhlela kwibar yezixhobo ukuze utshintshe phakathi koku: uhlelo lwezandla, A→Z, Z→A, Ezisalindileyo kuqala, okanye Ezigqityiweyo kuqala. Unako kwakhona ukurhola nayiphi na into ngesiphatho sayo ukuze uyibeke kanye apho ufuna khona — imowudi yakho yokuhlela ekhethiweyo iyakhunjulwa kwinqaku ngalinye.
faq_delete_note_a: Swayiphela ikhadi lenqaku ngasekhohlo ukuze uveze ukhetho lokucima, okanye ucinezele ixesha elide ukuze ungene kwimowudi yokukhetha amaninzi kwaye ucime amanqaku amaninzi ngaxeshanye. Amanqaku acinyiweyo aya kwindawo yokulahla inkunkuma — vula iSetingi → Indawo yokulahla inkunkuma ukuze ubuyisele okanye ucime ngonaphakade.
faq_recover_note_a: Ewe. Amanqaku acinyiweyo awaze asuswe kwangoko — aya kwindawo yokulahla inkunkuma kuqala. Vula iSetingi → Indawo yokulahla inkunkuma, fumana inqaku lakho, kwaye ucofe Buyisela ukuze ulibuyise. Amanqaku aphuma kwindawo yokulahla inkunkuma ngonaphakade kuphela xa ucofa Indawo yokulahla inkunkuma, ngoko unexesha elininzi lokulungisa impazamo.
faq_share_note_a: Cinezele ixesha elide inqaku kwaye ucofe i-icon yabelana ukuze ulithumele njengombhalo oqhelekileyo. Umxholo uqulunqwa ngokohlobo — izinto zoluhlu lokukhangela zibandakanya imeko yazo yokukhangela, iiresiphi zibala izithako kunye namanyathelo, isicwangciso sohambo sibonisa indawo nganye ekuyiwa kuzo kunye nomhla kunye nexesha. Ukwabelana ngamanqaku amaninzi ngaxeshanye, cinezele ixesha elide ikhadi ukuze ungene kwimowudi yokukhetha amaninzi, khetha inani eliyimfuneko, emva koko ucofe i-icon yabelana kwibar ephezulu.
faq_change_colour_a: Vula inqaku kwaye ucofe ⋮ → Tshintsha Umbala ukuze ukhethe kwimixholo yemibala ekhoyo (efana ne-Sunset, Lavender, Rose, kunye ne-Forest). Umbala okhethiweyo uvela njengomgca ogxininisayo kwikhadi lenqaku kuluhlu, okwenza kube lula ukwahlula amanqaku ngokubonakalayo shwaka. Umbala ungowe-note nganye kwaye unokutshintshwa nangaliphi na ixesha.
